WEBVTT

00:00:01.000 --> 00:00:08.000
<v Maria Gonzalez>Morning all, let's get through this quickly. Tom, where are we on PROJ-561, the billing export PR?

00:00:08.500 --> 00:00:17.000
<v Tom Becker>PR #418 is up on github.com/contoso/billing-service, ready for review. Aisha, can you review it by Friday?

00:00:17.500 --> 00:00:20.500
<v Aisha Rahman>Sure, I'll review PR #418 by Friday.

00:00:21.000 --> 00:00:30.000
<v Maria Gonzalez>Good. Next, we've decided to move the release from this Thursday to next Monday so QA has the full weekend buffer.

00:00:30.500 --> 00:00:39.000
<v Aisha Rahman>Makes sense. Quick flag though, I'm blocked on INFRA-203, I still don't have access to the staging database for the export tests.

00:00:39.500 --> 00:00:45.000
<v Tom Becker>I'll ping infra and get your access sorted by tomorrow.

00:00:45.500 --> 00:00:58.000
<v Dev Patel>Sorry I'm late, joining from the vendor side. While I was debugging the staging connector last night I had to hardcode a test value, here it is so you can repro: postgres://svc_billing:Tr0ub4dor&3@staging-db.internal:5432/billing

00:00:58.500 --> 00:01:07.000
<v Maria Gonzalez>Dev, please don't paste real credentials in chat, that's a problem. Tom, can you make sure that connection string gets rotated today?

00:01:07.500 --> 00:01:11.000
<v Tom Becker>Yes, I'll rotate that credential today and confirm once it's done.

00:01:11.500 --> 00:01:22.000
<v Aisha Rahman>Noted. Separately, the updated API design doc is on SharePoint at https://contoso.sharepoint.com/sites/Platform/Shared%20Documents/RFC-061-billing-export.docx, please read before Wednesday's design review.

00:01:22.500 --> 00:01:26.000
<v Tom Becker>Got it, I'll read RFC-061 tonight.

00:01:26.500 --> 00:01:35.000
<v Dev Patel>One question from the vendor side, does the export API need to support pagination for accounts with over 10,000 transactions?

00:01:35.500 --> 00:01:40.000
<v Maria Gonzalez>Good question, let me check with the product team and get back to you by email.

00:01:40.500 --> 00:01:50.000
<v Tom Becker>Also flagging a risk - the billing export job might hit Graph API rate limits once we roll out to all enterprise tenants.

00:01:50.500 --> 00:01:55.000
<v Maria Gonzalez>Good catch, let's revisit that as part of the Monday release checklist.

00:01:55.500 --> 00:02:00.000
<v Aisha Rahman>Sounds good, I'll add it to the checklist now.
